subject: Keynote access promo codes — Redwood x BrightStage (distribution)
messages:
From: Sophie Park <sophie@brightstage.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, partners@openwave.co
Date: 2026-12-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Keynote access promo codes — Redwood x BrightStage

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for agreeing to provide attendee trial access for the BrightStage keynote. We discussed a short promo to let attendees try Redwood Inference for 30 days with a small credit bundle. Can you confirm you can provide single-use codes (unique per email) and whether we should limit redemptions to conference-registered emails only?

Initial ask from the events team: 350 single-use codes, 30-day credit bundle (equivalent of ~$50 usage), redeemable only during the conference week and expiring two weeks after.

Also looping in OpenWave (copartner) since they will help distribute on-site signage and the registration desk. We need a CSV with codes and a basic tracking template so we can match redemptions to promo placements.

Can you confirm turnaround (we're hoping to have codes ready by Dec 4)?

Cheers,
Sophie Park
Partnerships — BrightStage
Sophie.Park@brightstage.com


From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: Sophie Park <sophie@brightstage.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-12-01T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Keynote access promo codes — Redwood x BrightStage

Hi Sophie — thanks for the details. Happy to support. Quick answers up front:

- We can generate single-use, email-tied codes and deliver them as a CSV.
- Redemption window: we can set activation only for conference-registered addresses (we'll accept a CSV of allowed emails) or make them single-use without email gating — your choice.
- 350 codes is fine; we can scale up to 500 if you'd like a buffer.
- Turnaround: I can have an initial batch ready by end of day Dec 4 if you approve scope and expiration.

Operational notes:
- Expiry behavior: we recommend expiry 30 days after redemption to reduce support friction. If you want forced expiration two weeks after issuance, we can set that, but it reduces trial time.
- Tracking: I'll attach a usage-tracking template and include a 'campaign_tag' parameter in the codes so we can report back on redemptions in HubSpot.
- Security: codes are single-use and will be rate-limited; I'll include a short instructions README in the zip.

Next steps for you: confirm whether you want email gating (send attendee list) and whether you'd like 350 or 500 codes. Also confirm the final expiry policy (14 days after issue vs 30 days after redemption).

If you confirm, I'll generate the CSV and pass to Marissa to attach billing metadata and update the HubSpot deal.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.ai

Markus / Sophie — quick note from ops/accounting:

- Budget: Promotional credits for BrightStage will be logged under marketing promotions (code: MKT-PROM-2026-Q4). We need to cap the total USD-equivalent value. 350 codes × $50 = $17,500. If you want a 500-code buffer, we need approval for up to $25,000.
- HubSpot: I'll apply a campaign tag and map codes to deal HS-87420. Sophie, please confirm HubSpot contact properties you want updated when a code is redeemed (e.g., first_demo_requested, keynote_attendee).
- Attachments: suggest we include a small banner image for the registration desk and a one-page usage guide. I've attached the tracking spreadsheet template that Markus mentioned.

Sophie: can you also confirm whether marketing will place the single-use codes on printed cards (on-site) or only distribute via email/slides? Print distribution increases risk of scanning/sharing and may require email-filter gating.

I'll provision the promo budget once Markus confirms the final code count.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole

marissa_cole@redwood.ai
